'''Kelly Krieble'''<ref name="dt-19527">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19527 BEHOLD   The Power of CHEESE], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 28 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19527/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19527/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''dr_divot'''<ref name="gpn-264">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=264 The Lollipop Guild], Game Players Network (dr_divot, 11 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. Krieble also published two constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] in December 2001.
